items.title: A g^r_d on a proper curve with H^0(O_X) = k satisfies r <= d, with equality forcing genus 0
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors

items.difficulty_reason: The lemma bounds linear systems on a curve by their degree (statement lines 659-665). The proof (lines 667-735) does real work in both directions: the inequality comes from the section-sequence dimension count with the triviality of L|_D, and the equality case needs a genuine trick, replacing L by its tensor powers via a doubling argument that propagates the dimension identity to L^tensor 2 and then to a high power with vanishing H^1 furnished by ampleness. H2: compact and standard, but the doubling propagation is a real step.
